Question: Will I get the MMT (MakeMyTrip) voucher if I renew the Mobile App through a partner instead of the company?

Question: What is BLS and why should I renew it?
Answer: BLS is the yearly renewal for perpetual BUSY 21 licences (Basic, Standard, Enterprise). Renewing BLS keeps eligible updates and new releases, support, and BLS-linked services such as connected GST functions active.

Question: What is the BLS renewal price / charge for Basic, Standard and Enterprise?
Answer: Current 360-day single-user BLS renewal prices: ₹4,000 for Basic, ₹6,500 for Standard and ₹7,500 for Enterprise, plus applicable GST.

Question: Is GST included in the BLS renewal price?
Answer: No. BLS renewal prices (₹4,000 Basic, ₹6,500 Standard, ₹7,500 Enterprise) are plus applicable GST.

Question: What happens if I don't renew BLS?
Answer: Basic, Standard and Enterprise are perpetual BUSY 21 plans. If BLS expires, the licensed software remains active and your existing data is not lost, but new releases, updates, support and BLS-linked services including connected GST functions become unavailable.

Question: Will my software stop working or my data be lost if BLS expires?
Answer: No. On BUSY 21 (Basic, Standard, Enterprise) the licensed software keeps working and your existing data is not lost. Only new releases, updates, support and BLS-linked services (including connected GST functions) stop until you renew.

Question: Can I install a new BUSY release after my BLS has expired?
Answer: Avoid installing releases issued after your BLS expiry: an unsupported version may run in Demo Mode. Renew BLS first, then update.

Question: What happens when a BUSY Magic subscription expires?
Answer: BUSY Magic plans (Start, Smart, Power, Power+) are subscription-only, with no separate BLS fee. When the subscription expires, the software switches to Demo Mode, so it must be renewed to keep working.

Question: Can I get the Mobile App cheaper (discount) with my BLS renewal?
Answer: Yes. After renewing BLS, you have 15 days to buy a new Mobile App or renew your existing one at ₹2,700 + GST per mobile app (25% off ₹3,600 + GST).

Question: What is the total renewal cost with BUSY Online and the Mobile App?
Answer: Example for a Standard single-user licence with BUSY Online Access: BLS ₹6,500 + Online ₹10,800 + Mobile App ₹3,600 = ₹20,900. With the Mobile App bought or renewed within 15 days of the BLS renewal at ₹2,700: ₹20,000. Prices exclude GST. The SQL cloud plan costs ₹6,000 more per 360 days.

Question: How much does BUSY Online (cloud access) renewal cost?
Answer: BUSY Online costs ₹10,800 per 360 days for Access or ₹16,800 per 360 days for SQL, excluding GST.

Question: Can I move from BUSY 21 to BUSY Magic instead of renewing BLS?
Answer: Yes. Existing BUSY 21 users can migrate to BUSY Magic, and the remaining BLS validity is adjusted as per the current migration policy. Existing BUSY 21 data can be used in BUSY Magic.

Question: What is the difference between renewing BUSY 21 and BUSY Magic?
Answer: BUSY 21 has a one-time licence fee; you can keep using the software and your data even after BLS expires, and the yearly BLS renewal keeps updates, support and connected GST services active. BUSY Magic has 360-day subscription plans without a separate BLS fee, and switches to Demo Mode if not renewed.
